note: Riverside County regional park campground in pine forest on the edge of Idyllwild village (San Jacinto Mountains), a half-mile walk from the market and gas station. Showers are coin-operated. A seasonal creek runs about January to June. Wood and charcoal fires may be barred in fire season (propane only). --Claude
